newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shiseido to build large U.S. cosmetics plant - paper.
newsitem.headline: Shiseido to build large U.S. cosmetics plant - paper.

text.p: Cosmetics maker Shiseido Co Ltd will invest more than 10 billion yen to build a plant in the United States, which will become one of the world's largest cosmetics plants, a Japanese newspaper said on Monday.
The company will also triple its production capacity at its existing plants in the United States and France in five years, the Japanese economic daily NIhon Keizai Shimbun said.
The new plant will be built in New Jersey and start operations in 1999, the paper said, adding that it will be able to produce 15,000 tonnes of cosmetics a year in 2003.
A spokesmen for Shiseido was not immediately available for comment.
